summary: Add a read-only candidate-work export report merging audit/catalog/resume

delivery.outcome: Add a `monag export` subcommand merging audit's untracked-GitHub-issue candidates, catalog's undescribed-repository candidates, and resume's existing open Planfile backlog into one reviewable JSON/Markdown staging list, so a human (or a separately authorized tool such as planfile/koru) has one place to review candidate work instead of running audit/catalog/resume by hand and cross-referencing them.
nonGoals: monag never creates, imports, queues or claims a Planfile ticket itself; export is a report only.
No integration code for koru or planfile in this slice -- the output is merely shaped to be easy to hand to either.
Closed untracked issues are excluded from candidates (already resolved, not work); audit still reports them.

architecture.decision: Add src/monag/export.py composing audit.scan()/catalog.scan()/resume.scan() (no new discovery or GitHub logic); wire a new `monag export` subcommand and JSON/Markdown reporting following the audit/catalog conventions.
architecture.rollback: Revert the application slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Export module and CLI wiring regression suite passes.
